Rely on the general web results found in Turns 2 and 4 which already contained the answer, rather than forcing a site-specific search that returns nothing.

The core error was the premature hallucination in Turn 5, not the failed specific search query later. The analysis ignores that the answer was actually found in general searches (Turn 4) and the agent simply failed to trust/record it correctly before inventing the site constraint.
